title: Auction HouseX
description: A fast-paced, player-driven auction house built for competitive servers. Buy, sell, and flip items instantly in a clean, high-performance GUI. Designed for Paper servers, this plugin keeps the economy moving and the profits flowing 🔥
body:
Take your server’s economy to the next level with a fast, competitive, and player-driven auction house inspired by top-tier SMP servers.

This plugin allows players to buy, sell, and flip items instantly through a clean and responsive GUI. Built specifically for Paper servers, it’s optimized for performance and designed to handle even the most active economies.

💰 Features
⚡ Fast & Optimized GUI – Smooth and lag-free browsing
🛒 Player Listings – Sell any item easily
🔍 Search & Filters – Find exactly what you need
⏳ Item Expiration – Automatic cleanup of old listings
📊 Sorting Options – Price, newest, and more
🔒 Secure Transactions – No dupes, no exploits
⚙️ Configurable – Customize limits, taxes, and settings
🧩 Paper Support – Built for modern servers
😎Type smarter, not harder—use 6m, 2k, 1b instead of long numbers.

🧠 Perfect For
SMP servers
Economy-based servers
PvP & competitive servers
Skyblock / survival economies

🚀 Performance
Built with performance as a priority:

Minimal lag impact
Efficient item handling
Scales with large playerbases

📌 Requirements
Paper (recommended)
Vault (for economy support)
